title: Explore by Style curved-badge carousel and style collection navigation

requirements.summary: Replace the home-top Shop by Style block with an Explore by Style heading and a horizontally scrollable curved-badge carousel placed above CinematicHeroSlider.
acceptanceCriteria: Home page (path "/") renders a top section above the existing CinematicHeroSlider.
Heading text is exactly "Explore by Style" and is visually centered, serif-styled, and uses the gold accent (#D4AF37).
A single-row, horizontally scrollable carousel of badges is present with no layout overflow/breakage on desktop or mobile.

file_operations.description: Replace the existing "Shop by Style" UI with the new top-of-home "Explore by Style" section: centered serif heading, gold accent styling, and a single-row horizontally scrollable badge carousel container compatible with the existing dark luxury theme.
Ensure the updated top section (ShopByStyleBlock now acting as Explore-by-Style) remains rendered above CinematicHeroSlider on the home section without altering other home layout blocks.

requirements.summary: Implement exactly 5 curved badges with specified category→label mappings and a left circular icon + text layout using pearl blue background.
acceptanceCriteria: Exactly 5 badges are shown (no Sequin, no Ready To Wear).
Each badge shows (1) a circular icon/image and (2) the exact impressive label text from the spec.
Badges use curved corners (25px radius) and a pearl blue background (#7FB3D5) consistent with the dark luxury theme.

file_operations.description: Implement the 5 badge items and mappings exactly: Banarasi→"Zari Royalty", Organza→"Sheer Elegance", Georgette→"Flowing Grace", Silk→"Silk Symphony", Kalamkari→"Heritage Artistry". Each badge must render a left circular icon image plus the impressive label, with 25px corner radius and pearl blue (#7FB3D5) styling.

requirements.summary: Add lightweight hover interactions (gold glow/border + subtle lift/scale to 1.05) respecting reduced-motion and not harming mobile scrolling.
acceptanceCriteria: Hovering a badge visibly adds a gold glow/border highlight and scales the badge to ~1.05 without jarring motion.
Hover behavior does not introduce heavy particle effects or complex animations.
The hover effect does not interfere with scrolling/swiping the carousel on mobile.

file_operations.description: Add hover/focus-visible styling to badges: gold glow/border highlight and transform scale to ~1.05 with a subtle lift, while disabling/toning down motion when reduced-motion is preferred (using the existing prefers-reduced-motion approach).
Add (or adjust) utility classes for the new explore-by-style badge hover glow/border and reduced-motion-safe transitions, avoiding heavy effects and keeping changes scoped to this new carousel.

requirements.summary: Make each badge clickable with SPA navigation to a real, consistent style-collection route that renders meaningful storefront content for all 5 categories.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking each badge changes the URL (SPA navigation) to a category-specific destination and does not reload the page.
The destination page renders correctly (no blank screen), and the user can navigate back to home normally.
The category destination is implemented for all 5 categories using a consistent slug scheme (e.g., banarasi/organza/georgette/silk/kalamkari).

file_operations.description: Create a storefront page that renders a meaningful style-collection view for a given style slug (banarasi/organza/georgette/silk/kalamkari), including a heading and a filtered product grid using existing product listing components/empty-state handling so the page is never blank.

Wire SPA route handling for a consistent style collection route pattern (e.g., "/collections/<slug>") using the existing useSpaLocation approach, rendering the new StyleCollectionsPage within the standard storefront shell (OceanBackground/Header/Footer/Toaster) and keeping other routes unchanged.

Make each badge clickable to navigate via useSpaLocation to the corresponding style collection route (e.g., /collections/banarasi, /collections/organza, /collections/georgette, /collections/silk, /collections/kalamkari) without page reload.

requirements.summary: Ensure the Explore by Style carousel is mobile-responsive, swipeable via native horizontal overflow, single-row, and consistent with the dark luxury palette.
acceptanceCriteria: On mobile, the badge row can be swiped horizontally (native overflow scrolling) and remains a single row without wrapping into broken layouts.
On desktop, the badge row is horizontally scrollable and visually aligned/centered within the existing page container constraints.
Colors match the provided palette and do not alter global theme tokens unexpectedly.

file_operations.description: Implement the carousel row layout as a single-line, horizontally scrollable container (native overflow scrolling) with appropriate spacing/padding so it remains swipeable on mobile and aligned within the existing max-width container on desktop; keep palette aligned to black background, pearl blue (#7FB3D5), and gold (#D4AF37).

requirements.summary: Add 5 generated circular-friendly icon assets under frontend/public/assets/generated and use them in the carousel badges as static images.
acceptanceCriteria: Five icon images exist in frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced directly via static paths.
Each of the 5 badges displays its corresponding icon image cropped/masked to a circle.
No new backend endpoints or canister calls are introduced to serve these images.

file_operations.description: Add the generated static icon asset: frontend/public/assets/generated/explore-style-icon-banarasi.dim_128x128.png.
Add the generated static icon asset: frontend/public/assets/generated/explore-style-icon-organza.dim_128x128.png.
Add the generated static icon asset: frontend/public/assets/generated/explore-style-icon-georgette.dim_128x128.png.
Add the generated static icon asset: frontend/public/assets/generated/explore-style-icon-silk.dim_128x128.png.
Add the generated static icon asset: frontend/public/assets/generated/explore-style-icon-kalamkari.dim_128x128.png.

Reference the 5 static generated icon files from frontend/public/assets/generated (as direct static paths) and render each icon masked/cropped to a circle within the left side of its corresponding badge.

requirements.summary: Keep changes scoped to the home-top redesign and its navigation destinations; avoid dashboard/profile/login regressions and avoid heavy visual effects.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard route (/dashboard) behavior and UI remain unchanged.
Login page and OTP verification flow remain functional and still land on "/" after success unless a return path is set.
No new particle systems or heavy background effects are added specifically for this section.

file_operations.description: Add only the minimal new storefront route handling needed for style collections while preserving all existing route branches (including /dashboard and /login) and avoiding changes to authentication flows.
Keep the implementation lightweight (no particle/heavy effects) and confined to the Explore-by-Style UI and its navigation, ensuring no cross-cutting changes to dashboard/profile/login components.
